stated_limitation: Despite the small sample size of individual time bins, the pooled pre-stim activity carries significant information about the animal's upcoming behavioral choice.

justification.dataset: No real dataset was used; data are fully synthetic and no DANDI file was streamed, despite the README naming 000070 and 000149 as sources.
justification.handling: All spike data are generated by np.random with a fixed seed, an automatic axis-2 zero and reject.
justification.analysis: Logistic-regression decoding is a sensible method in the abstract, but here it merely recovers a choice signal the code injected into the pre-stimulus bins, so it tests nothing real.
justification.correctness: The 55.6% value reproduces from the seeded code, but it is a circular artifact of injected signal on fabricated data, not a measurement of any phenomenon.
justification.figures: Figures are readable but display only the synthetic, pre-baked effect rather than any real analysis.
justification.honesty: The write-up presents a tautological result on simulated data as a scientific finding and falsely lists two DANDI dandisets as its data source.
